jobs.title: Performance Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
### **Description**


The Performance Marketing Coordinator supports the Performance Marketing team by coordinating paid media, affiliate partnerships, influencer attribution, PR seeding, email, and advertising\-related initiatives. This role is designed for a high\-potential marketing professional who is building experience in performance marketing and is interested in developing hands\-on knowledge across major paid media platforms and business suites.


The coordinator will work closely with the Performance Marketing Manager, cross\-functional teams, and external partners to keep campaigns organized, support partner communications, coordinate creative needs, track performance, and contribute to the continued growth of ABH’s performance marketing programs.

**Paid Media \& Performance Marketing Support**

* Support paid media and performance marketing initiatives across Meta, TikTok, Google, Amazon, and other relevant channels.
* Develop working knowledge of major paid media business suites and platform tools, including Meta Business Suite, TikTok Ads Manager, Google Ads, Amazon Ads, and related reporting platforms.
* Assist with campaign calendars, briefs, launch timelines, asset handoffs, approvals, status tracking, and campaign documentation.
* Coordinate with the Performance Marketing Manager, Creative, Ecommerce, Social, Brand Marketing, and external agency partners to help ensure campaigns launch accurately and on schedule.
* Support weekly and monthly performance reporting by compiling data, identifying notable trends, and flagging opportunities or items requiring follow\-up.
* Assist with tracking campaign spend, pacing, performance, testing activity, and results under manager guidance.
* Maintain organized documentation of campaign plans, creative assets, reports, testing results, and key learnings.
* Provide administrative and operational support to help the Performance Marketing team execute efficiently.

**Affiliate \& Partnership Support**

* Source, evaluate, and maintain a pipeline of prospective TikTok, Amazon, and other affiliate partners aligned with brand and campaign objectives.
* Support the day\-to\-day coordination of affiliate and performance partnership programs across platforms such as Rakuten, LTK, ShopMy, and other relevant affiliate networks or creator\-commerce partners.
* Support affiliate outreach, onboarding, relationship management, product seeding, and campaign coordination.
* Maintain accurate affiliate and partner records, including contact information, deliverables, status updates, tracking links, promotional codes, content requirements, and key deadlines.
* Coordinate affiliate content requests, promotional calendars, campaign briefs, and required campaign materials.
* Monitor affiliate activity and assist with reporting on performance, including traffic, conversions, revenue, content output, and other relevant program metrics.
* Support affiliate partnership renewals and new partnership opportunities by coordinating communications, gathering internal inputs, organizing documentation, tracking next steps, and supporting commercial and contract\-related coordination under manager guidance.
* Assist with partner briefings, meeting preparation, follow\-ups, and recap documentation.

**Influencer Attribution, PR \& Earned Media Coordination**

* Support influencer attribution by maintaining creator records, tracking links, promotional codes, content details, campaign deliverables, and performance data.
* Support PR and earned media initiatives by coordinating product requests, seeding lists, outreach tracking, shipment details, materials, and follow\-up communications.
* Maintain media, creator, affiliate, and partner lists as needed.
* Assist with tracking earned media coverage, seeded content, influencer activity, affiliate activity, and partnership deliverables for reporting purposes.
* Help ensure influencer, affiliate, PR, and paid media activity is aligned with larger campaign and product priorities.

**Creative Coordination**

* Partner with the Creative team to coordinate asset needs for paid media, affiliate marketing, influencer campaigns, PR seeding, and email.
* Assist with preparing and tracking creative briefs that include campaign objectives, key messaging, platform specifications, requested deliverables, and deadlines.
* Track creative asset status, feedback, and approvals to help ensure materials are delivered on time and in the correct specifications.
* Support the coordination of marketing calendars, creative assets, approvals, launch timelines, testing documentation, and performance reporting as needed.
* Help maintain campaign calendars and ensure that paid media, affiliate, partnership, influencer, and PR, activities are coordinated across teams.
* Support the trafficking and coordination of campaign assets for international markets as needed.

### **Requirements**

* 1\- 3 years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, paid media, ecommerce, affiliate marketing, influencer marketing, partnerships, public relations, email marketing, or a related field. Relevant internship experience may be considered.
* Strong interest in learning paid media platforms and business suites across Meta, TikTok, Google, Amazon, and other relevant channels.
* Familiarity with, or strong willingness to learn, affiliate platforms, creator\-commerce tools, campaign trackers, and reporting systems.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, deadlines, and follow\-up items.
* Analytical mindset and comfort working with spreadsheets, reporting tools, campaign performance data, and shared project\-management systems.
* Strong attention to detail, initiative, accountability, and a collaborative working style.
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience with Google Analytics, Tableau, Triple Whale, Northbeam, Salesforce Marketing

jobs.title: Office Manager / Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------


Stic is modernizing out\-of\-home, one of advertising's oldest formats. Billboards and transit ads have always sold impressions on faith. Stic replaces faith by turning everyday vehicles into GPS\-tracked, mobile media. Brands get proof instead of best guesses. Drivers earn passive income on miles they're already driving.


Stic Vision is how it works. An edge AI device small enough to live inside a decal, streaming informative analytics with no vehicle\-level integration required.


The global out\-of\-home advertising market is worth roughly $40 billion a year. Stic is building the measurement layer that legacy OOH never had.


Stic is trusted by brands like TikTok, Dunkin Donuts, e.l.f., and PacSun. The traction is already showing up in results: a SXSW campaign for TikTok Radio put 44 vehicles on the road in Austin and generated 3\.9 million tracked impressions. That's real, revenue\-generating proof in a category still mostly sold on assumptions.


Stic is lean by design. People joining now build the playbook rather than inheriting one. This means fast execution and explosive career growth, without the layers of process that slows things down at bigger companies.

**About You**


You make administration disappear. The executive you support stops thinking about their inbox. The office runs without reminders, and campaigns never stall over logistics. Nobody on the team books their own travel.


You see what needs doing before anyone asks, then own it end to end. You take real pride in order and follow\-through. Loose ends bother you, so you close them. If you like being the quiet operating system behind a busy team, you'll like it here.

 **What You Will Own**

* **Your executive's time \-** you'll take over their inbox and calendar so they only see what needs their judgment. Everything else gets handled, routed, or filed before it reaches them. Nothing waiting on their approval sits for more than a business day.
* **The office \-** kitchen supplies, deliveries, food and meals, vendor coordination, and building management all run without anyone having to think about it. The space stays tidy and stocked as a matter of course, not as a fire drill.
* **Operations and logistics \-** you'll build and run the systems that keep physical campaign materials (stickers, decals, and similar) moving. Organizing them by campaign, mapping the pickup and delivery cycle including manufacturer lead times, and keeping everything on a predictable schedule. The goal: no campaign or install is ever delayed by a supply or logistics gap.
* **Travel \-** you'll own executive and sales travel end to end, so account executives stop booking their own. Requests go from ask to confirmed itinerary within a business day, and trips don't get disrupted by booking errors.
* **Make it repeatable \-** you'll document the recurring work clearly enough that someone else could pick it up cold. You’ll keep documentation current so the office never depends on you being in the room.




**What Success Looks Like**

We believe in being specific about what "good" means, so you know exactly what you're walking into:

* **By 30 days**: you're fluent in our tools (including Jira), actively managing the inbox and calendar, and the office essentials (supplies, deliveries, food, vendors, building management) run without escalation.
* **By 60–90 days**: the executive reads only what needs their decision; logistics for pickups and deliveries run on a schedule without prompting; and you own all executive and sales travel.
* **By 6 months**: the recurring work is documented well enough that another person could cover the inbox, calendar, and office logistics for a full week using your notes alone.
* **Across the year**: zero campaigns delayed by logistics, zero trips derailed by a booking error, and documentation that stays current quarter over quarter.

**What You’ll Need to Have**

* Experience as an executive assistant, office manager, or operations coordinator \- ideally some blend of all three.
* Proactive to a fault. You spot the gap and close it before it's raised.
* A track record of booking and managing complex travel.
* Deeply organized, with the follow\-through to match. Loose ends genuinely bother you.
* Comfortable owning logistics and vendor relationships, and coordinating moving parts across people and timelines.
* A clear, concise writer, a big part of this role is communicating on the executive's behalf.
* Quick to learn new tools and systems (we use Jira; you don't need to know it on day one, but you should be able to get proficient fast).
* Discreet and trustworthy with sensitive information and a busy leader's time.
* Happy working in\-office and being the hub the team relies on.
* Ideally, experience in a startup or other fast\-moving environment, familiarity with Jira or similar project\-tracking tools, a background in physical logistics, inventory, or supply coordination.

**Base Salary:** $35 \- $41 an hour, plus benefits


**Work Location:** Los Angeles \- in person

**Benefits**

* Join a well\-funded early\-stage company disrupting traditional advertising with patent pending technology
* Explosive career growth
* Health \& dental insurance
* 26 days off per year (15 PTO / 11 holidays) prorated for any partial year of employment
* 401(k)

**Equal Employment Opportunity**


Stic is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, disability, genetic information, medical condition, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, comp

jobs.title: MPS Program Coordinator (4973C) - MPS Dean's Office
jobs.description:
MPS Program Coordinator (4973C) \- MPS Dean's Office About Berkeley
  
  

At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation \- driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  

At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full\-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and providing space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  

We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Pla n, which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  

Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride.
  
  

Departmental Overview
  
  

The MPS Dean's Diversity Office initiates, implements, and evaluates efforts and conducts research on student, postdoc, and faculty success in the mathematical and physical science fields with an emphasis on ensuring fair access and equitable outcomes. The Assistant Dean and their staff organize new initiatives, develop new funding, and support departmental efforts to students, and receive all work duties directly from the Assistant Dean. Collaborates with professors, graduate students, postdoctoral fellows, faculty, staff, and administrators from UCB and national partners.
  
  

Currently projects underway include MPS Scholars and the MPS Scholarship Program at the undergraduate level, a doctoral advancement program, and a postdoc study. This position is responsible for providing programmatic, administrative, and financial coordination for MPS Dean's Office. Provides support to the Assistant Dean. The Assistant Dean advises the Deans and Department Chairs, manages and provides assistance to several student organizations, conducts research, develops new programs, and works to enhance equity among the faculty, staff, and students in the MPS departments.
  
  

The position requires in\-depth understanding of campus policies and administrative practices. The position holder is a key point of contact for all MPS Dean's Office business and must be able to work with a high degree of independence with good judgement and follow through.
  
  

MPS Scholars is the official student success and mentorship program of the Mathematical and Physical Sciences (MPS) Dean's Office, offered collaboratively with the Departments of Astronomy, Earth and Planetary Science, Mathematics, and Physics. Open to all intended and declared MPS majors, MPS Scholars provides opportunities to build community, explore academic and career pathways, and thrive throughout the Berkeley experience.
  
  

Since launching in Fall 2022, thousands of students have participated in MPS Scholars through mentorship, events, workshops, and academic and career resources.
  
  

MPS Scholars is a structured program, supported by funding from the Gordon and Betty Moore Foundation. It provides activities and opportunities such as: A supportive mentoring network of advanced students, faculty, professional scientists, and alumni. Welcome and orientation programs for incoming students. Research and internship opportunities in academic and industry settings. Career development workshops, courses, networking events, and graduate school preparation. Academic resources designed to support success in MPS majors. Retreats, social events, and community\-building activities that connect students with peers, graduate mentors, staff, alumni, and faculty across the MPS departments.
  
  

The Mathematical and Physical Sciences Scholarship Program (MPSSP) awards up to $15,000 per year in scholarship support to eligible students in Astronomy, Earth and Planetary Science, Mathematics, and Physics. Funded by the National Science Foundation's S\-STEM program, MPSSP scholars receive financial support while participating fully in the MPS Scholars community.
  
  

At the graduate level, a bridge grant from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation grant is focused on establishing a prototype for the establishment of a Sloan Center for Systemic Change (SCSC) at Berkeley by establishing a consortium of departments working together to advance their equity goals.
  
  

At the postdoctoral level, the Postdoc Study, supported by a grant from the Heising\-Simons Foundation, is designed to provide a clearer understanding of the experiences of postdoctoral scholars and causes of patterns of career selection among postdocs in the MPS fields at top\-tier universities and national research facilities.
  
  

The MPS Program Coordinator coordinates and administers academic support and student success programs within the Mathematical and Physical Sciences (MPS) Dean's Office, including MPS Scholars and the NSF S\-STEM Scholarship Program. The position supports the development and implementation of programs designed to enhance the academic, professional, and personal success of undergraduate and graduate students, with particular attention to students who may face barriers to academic success.
  
  

Working under the direction of the Assistant Dean and in collaboration with faculty, staff, students, and campus and external partners, the Program Coordinator provides programmatic support, coordinates mentoring and professional development activities, supports students in navigating academic and other challenges, and assists with program assessment and evaluation. jobs.title: Market Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Join Ecolab’s sales team as a **Market Sales Representative** in the **New York City** market. Within our industry leading Institutional division, grow sales within an existing territory of accounts by utilizing consultative sales techniques to enhance Ecolab’s total value to the customer. Own customer relationships, expand solution adoption, and drive new business. Cultivate customer and industry relationships that result in increased sales and trust for Ecolab's brand and leverage market knowledge to identify and close competitive sales opportunities in cleaning and sanitation, safety, quality and operations.

**How You’ll Make an Impact:**

* Drive outsized growth, in major, high growth markets, by meeting or exceeding growth and revenue targets across assigned accounts or geography
* Leverage market knowledge to identify, develop, and gain new competitive business opportunities within assigned geographic area
* Build and manage a healthy sales pipeline using CRM and digital sales tools
* Communicate our total value to the customer and grow solutions within existing customer accounts
* Provide industry expertise to customers in terms of cleaning and sanitation, safety, quality and operations by recommending sanitation plans and programs, implementing and evaluating standard operating procedures, identifying and implementing operational efficiencies and providing employee training
* Partner with service and internal teams to ensure best in class value delivery

**Position Details:**

* Territory covers about a 60\-mile radius of the surrounding area
* 10% overnight travel required

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree
* 2 years of sales experience
* Experience in broadline distribution, customer service, foodservice, hospitality, or a related industry
* Position requires a current and valid driver’s license
* Ecolab conducts a background check and drug screens on all candidates who receive a job offer
* No Immigration Sponsorship available

**Physical Requirements:**

*Ecolab is committed to providing reasonable* *accommodation* *to qualified individuals with a disability.*

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Previous business to business commercial sales experience
* Sales specific education or certifications
* Prospecting or new business development experience
* Ability to sell value and outcomes, not just products
* Comfort using CRM and digital sales tools

**What’s in it For You:**

Discover how our partnership with customers helps serve 45 billion restaurant meals and clean more than one billion hotel rooms annually. From restaurants, hotels, and long\-term care facilities, to schools, commercial buildings, and military facilities, Ecolab’s Institutional division provides a comprehensive program of customized cleaning and sanitizing solutions to help meet the specific needs of our customers. Join us and help the biggest and best brands ensure guest safety and satisfaction and protect their reputation.

The total compensation range for this position is $90,700 \- $136,100, which includes base pay and target incentive based on performance, per plan terms. jobs.company: Peachtree Dunwoody Oral and Facial Surgery
jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
Peachtree Dunwoody Oral and Facial


5505 Peachtree Dunwoody Road, Suite 660


Sandy Springs, GA 30342

**POSITION PURPOSE**
--------------------


The **Marketing \& Referral Coordinator** is responsible for building, maintaining, and strengthening relationships with referring dental offices while increasing patient referrals and community awareness of the oral surgery practice.


This position combines **field\-based outreach with in\-office referral development and marketing activities**. The Coordinator will visit referring offices, conduct referral calls and follow\-up, track referral activity, coordinate outreach initiatives and events, and identify opportunities to grow existing and new referral relationships.


The ideal candidate is professional, outgoing, organized, self\-motivated, and comfortable building relationships with doctors, dental professionals, and community partners.

**PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES \& DUTIES**
----------------------------------------

### **Referral Development \& Outreach**

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with dentists, dental specialists, physicians, and their office teams.
* Conduct regular visits to existing and prospective referring offices to promote the practice, providers, services, and patient experience.
* Identify and develop new referral relationships within the community.
* Conduct referral calls, thank referring offices, and provide appropriate follow\-up regarding referrals and scheduling.
* Re\-engage offices with declining or inactive referral activity and identify opportunities to strengthen relationships.
* Deliver marketing materials, educational information, referral resources, and approved appreciation items to referring offices.
* Coordinate and participate in office visits, lunches, open houses, study clubs, educational programs, and other outreach events.

### **Referral Tracking \& Growth**

* Maintain an accurate referral database and document office visits, calls, follow\-up activities, and relationship\-development opportunities.
* Monitor referral activity and identify trends by referring office and provider.
* Prepare referral reports and communicate trends, concerns, and growth opportunities to surgeons and practice leadership.
* Establish and work toward measurable referral\-development and outreach goals.
* Participate in regular marketing and referral strategy discussions with practice leadership.

### **Marketing \& Practice Promotion**

* Assist with marketing initiatives designed to increase referrals, patient volume, and practice awareness.
* Support website and social media content to ensure practice information is accurate, engaging, and current.
* Coordinate marketing materials, referral resources, promotional items, and event needs.
* Partner with practice leadership and the Marketing Department to ensure outreach activities align with practice goals.
* Assist with employee engagement activities and special projects as needed.
* Provide occasional front\-office support based on business needs.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**
--------------------------

* Experience in **marketing, business development, referral outreach, sales, customer relationship management, or a related field**; healthcare or dental experience preferred.
* Strong relationship\-building, customer service, and communication skills.
* Professional and confident when communicating with doctors and dental office teams.
* Comfortable conducting frequent telephone outreach and face\-to\-face office visits.
* Self\-motivated, organized, and able to work independently while remaining accountable to established goals.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and demonstrate strong follow\-through.
* Familiarity with social media, digital marketing, and basic referral/data tracking.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and ability to learn practice management or CRM systems.
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation for local travel.

**PREFERRED SKILLS**
--------------------

* Dental or oral surgery experience.
* Knowledge of dental terminology and the dental referral process.
* Sales, marketing, account management, or business\-development experience.
* Experience tracking referral sources and marketing metrics.
* Event planning or community outreach experience.

**PHYSICAL \& WORK REQUIREMENTS**
---------------------------------

* Ability to travel locally to referring offices and events.
* Ability to lift and carry marketing materials and supplies up to 25 pounds.
* Ability to work both independently in the field and collaboratively within the practice.
* Occasional attendance at events outside normal business hours may be required.

jobs.title: Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Development Coordinator**

**Marketing \& Development Department**

**Tapestry 360 Health**




Tapestry 360 Health is a mission\-driven, patient\-centered Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) delivering comprehensive primary care, behavioral health, and enabling services to a diverse and underserved population. As a Health Resources and Services Administration\-designated health center operating under Section 330 of the Public Health Service Act, Tapestry serves as a critical safety\-net provider, ensuring access to high\-quality, equitable care regardless of a patient’s ability to pay.


With a workforce of approximately 250 employees and an annual operating budget of $44 million, the organization is advancing a deliberate strategy focused on financial sustainability, operational rigor, and long\-term community impact. Key priorities include strengthening core infrastructure, expanding value\-based care arrangements to align reimbursement with outcomes, and optimizing participation in the 340B Drug Pricing Program to reinvest resources into patient care. Through this integrated approach, Tapestry 360 Health is positioned to sustain and scale mission\-critical services for the communities it serves well into the future.

The Development Coordinator plays a vital role in supporting Tapestry 360 Health's fundraising operations by ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and efficiency of the organization's donor database, gift processing, and fundraising systems. This position is responsible for maintaining donor records, processing and acknowledging charitable gifts, reconciling contributions with Finance, producing fundraising reports and analytics, managing online giving platforms, supporting grant reporting, and coordinating the operational aspects of fundraising events and campaigns.

**Gift Processing \& Financial Reconciliation**

* Secure auction items and maintain procurement records.
* Manage event registration systems, attendee databases, guest lists, seating assignments, name badges, donor recognition materials, and post\-event reporting and reconciliation.

**Administrative \& Donor Stewardship Support**

* Maintain electronic fundraising files and documentation.
* Support donor stewardship, direct mail campaigns, and donor communications.
* Update and maintain the donor pages on Tapestry 360 Health’s website.
* Participate in departmental planning and perform other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Office Manager & On-Site Events Coordinator
jobs.description:
Bexley Seabury Seminary operates primarily online, but our community relies on a well\-run physical presence to support faculty, staff, and students. We are seeking a dependable, detail\-oriented professional to manage our office, coordinate the shipment of materials and equipment, and provide on\-site support for the events that bring our community together in person a few times each year.

Position Overview

* Hours: approximately 10 hours/week on average, with additional hours around on\-site events as described below
* Pay: $20/hour; travel in the greater Chicago area occasionally required. Mileage reimbursement for travel, other than regular commute to St. James Commons, is available.
* Location: must reside in the Chicago area; weekly access to our downtown Chicago office at St. James Commons (65 E Huron St Chicago, Chicago, IL 60611\) required, with periodic travel within the greater Chicago area
* Schedule: largely flexible and self\-directed, with occasional Saturday work (2–4 times/year) and availability required for a late\-August weekend
* Reports to: Dean of Student and Community Engagement
* Start date: Negotiable between October 15 and 30, 2026

This role supports the day\-to\-day operations of a seminary that conducts most of its work online. Routine responsibilities include managing mail and inventory, and ensuring faculty and staff have the materials and equipment they need. Typically five to six times a year, the scope expands to include on\-site event support—coordinating hospitality for a class session, managing logistics for Commencement Week (mid\-May), or supporting Orientation Weekend (late August). This position suits someone comfortable balancing independent, steady administrative work with concentrated periods of hands\-on event coordination.

Qualifications

* Must reside in the Chicago area, with reliable weekly access to our downtown Chicago office and the ability to travel within the greater Chicago area a few times per year
* Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage inventory and logistics independently
* Ability to lift and carry boxes of materials or equipment weighing up to 30 lbs
* Comfort with basic AV/technology setup
* A reliable, self\-directed work style suited to a part\-time role with general rather than day\-to\-day supervision
* A professional, welcoming presence—this person may serve as the first in\-person point of contact for faculty, staff, students, and guests during on\-site events
* Discretion in handling sensitive mail and materials
* Flexibility to work occasional Saturdays and the August Orientation Weekend
* Valid driver's license or reliable access to public transit for all on\-site locations
* Background check required, given regular on\-site access and interaction with students

Weekly \& Ongoing Responsibilities

The following form the core of the role in a typical week:

* Pick up incoming mail and packages at our downtown Chicago office; sort, log, and forward to the appropriate faculty or staff member as needed
* Establish and maintain organization of the office space
* Maintain inventory of promotional materials and swag, tracking stock levels and reordering items as necessary
* Maintain inventory of IT/AV equipment kept on\-site
* Ship promotional materials, swag, and IT/AV equipment to faculty and staff for conferences, events, or day\-to\-day needs
* Provide clear instructions and troubleshooting support to faculty and staff shipping materials back to the office
* Respond to routine requests related to office resources, shipping, and inventory
* Serve as first point of contact for facilities issues at the office, escalating to building management as needed
* Send–or make arrangements to send–gifts, flowers, or get\-well items on behalf of Bexley Seabury as directed by the Dean of Student and Community Engagement or her designee
* Print and mail hard\-copy acknowledgments for gifts made to the Seminary as directed by the Dean of Student and Community Engagement or her designee
* Other duties as assigned by the Dean of Student and Community Engagement

Tasks That Ebb and Flow Through the Year

The following responsibilities cluster around specific points in the calendar, resulting in busier periods offset by lighter weeks throughout the rest of the year.

After conferences and promotional events (year\-round, as scheduled)

* Receive and restock returned promotional materials and swag
* Reconcile outgoing and returned materials, and update inventory accordingly
* Reorder depleted stock

On\-site classes (3\-5 times per year; typically in January, March or April, June or July, and October or November)

Classes typically take place at St. James Commons/St. James Cathedral in Chicago, IL, with one two\-day course scheduled each spring at St. Mark’s Episcopal Church in Evanston, IL. Hours for class support will typically include a few hours at the beginning and end of the course for set up and tear down, but may extend to a few hours for each day of the course (two to five days) depending on course needs.

* Coordinate with the building contact to confirm space, schedule, and access
* Procure, set up, and clean up snacks and hospitality for the class, accounting for any dietary needs communicated in advance
* Set up instructor tech needs, such as a TV cart or other AV equipment
* Provide on\-site troubleshooting support during class sessions
* Restock classroom or hospitality supplies afterward

Commencement Week (mid\-May, Tuesday–Friday)

Commencement week typically takes place at St. James Commons/St. James Cathedral in Chicago, IL. Depending on support needs and availability, we anticipate this could range from 5\-15 hours in addition to the normal 10 hours for the week.

* Serve as building liaison for space scheduling across the week's events
* Arrange meals and hospitality, coordinating with vendors and accounting for dietary and accessibility needs
* Provide on\-site logistical support (setup, ma
